applicant_response.note: SEC-312-1: applicants get their own item projection (lists.applicant_case_item). grounds and reason come only from the actor's own newest submitted petition on the case (owner = actor); [] and null when the actor has filed none, even if the other party has. No party names, no genders, no next_step. respondent_name and party_names stay out until ctm3-product-lead answers design risk 6 (deny by default).

errors.note: Only reached with a valid CSRF token (a browser session always has one). A bare unauthenticated POST gets the CSRF 403 first.

errors.when: CSRF header missing or wrong (also an unauthenticated POST without a token)
errors.note: Django CsrfViewMiddleware answers with its HTML 403 page (no CSRF_FAILURE_VIEW). It runs before the endpoint, so it is also what an unauthenticated POST without a token gets instead of 401. CTMServerList treats any non-JSON error as a generic failure (Retry row) and never parses the body.

errors.when: page not an integer from 1 to 1000000 (also the string "1", true, 1.5)

messages: page must be an integer from 1 to 1000000.

errors.when: size not an integer from 1 to 100 (also the string "50", true, 1.5)

messages: size must be an integer from 1 to 100.

errors.when: sort field not allowed for this list and role
more than 3 sort entries or dir not asc/desc

messages: Use up to 3 sort entries, each with dir asc or desc.

errors.when: q shorter than 2 or longer than 200 characters after trimming (empty is allowed)

messages: Search text must be 2 to 200 characters.

errors.when: filter key not allowed for this list and role
applicant sends filters.mine, filters.assigned, filters.ground or a council-only sort field (applicant search is number only, never refused: other text just matches nothing)
filters.status not open, closed or any

messages: status must be open, closed or any.

errors.when: filters.ids not a list of 1 to 100 UUIDs

messages: ids must list 1 to 100 case ids.

errors.when: filters.ground not one of infidelity, abandonment, abuse, faith, addiction, concealment

messages: ground must be one of the six ground codes.

extra_requests.purpose: council search by manager full name
extra_requests.returns: the case above; q matches Concat(first_name, ' ', last_name)

extra_requests.purpose: council filter by ground while a filing is returned for correction (SEC-312-2)
extra_requests.returns: total 0 when abuse exists only in a private correction revision saved after the return; also after that filing is withdrawn (SEC-312-2a); the filter and the item's grounds read the council-visible revision (the current_version revision when revision_visible, else the latest Submission.revision)
